kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نكترب (form VIII)
# نَكْتَرِبُ (naktaribu) /nak.ta.ri.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَرَبَ (iktaraba)
# نَكْتَرِبَ (naktariba) /nak.ta.ri.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَرَبَ (iktaraba)
# نَكْتَرِبْ (naktarib) /nak.ta.rib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِكْتَرَبَ (iktaraba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
